# Vendored page-turn engine

`page-flip.browser.js` and `page-flip.css` are from [`page-flip@2.0.7`](https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip), distributed under the included MIT license. The engine is used in HTML-page mode for the two-page landscape herbarium spread. Source and package documentation: https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
